rulings.claim: Charles Rossbach III resided at the Cedar Road Property without paying rent.
rulings.reason: The notice addressed to Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach III states they had not paid rent.
rulings.evidenceQuote: To: Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach III... you have no rental agreement and are not a tenant; you have not paid any rent
rulings.judgeReason: The notice addressed to Charles Rossbach III at the Cedar Road property states he had not paid rent, directly supporting the claim that he resided there without paying rent.

rulings.problem: The cited probate record gives Anthony Notarian's date of death as February 21, 2020, not February 22, 2020.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 4 expressly states the decedent died on 02/21/2020.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Decedent died ... on 02/21/2020 domiciled in CHESTER TOWNSHIP.
rulings.judgeReason: The probate record expressly states the decedent died on 02/21/2020, contradicting the brief's claim of February 22, 2020.

rulings.claim: Maria Scalzo was appointed Fiduciary of the Estate of Anthony Notarian on July 7, 2020.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 4 shows Maria Scalzo was appointed fiduciary on July 7, 2020.
rulings.evidenceQuote: The Court therefore appoints MARIA SCALZO aka MARISA SCALZO as such fiduciary... Date: July 7, 2020
rulings.judgeReason: The probate order appoints Maria Scalzo as fiduciary on July 7, 2020, matching the claim exactly.

rulings.claim: Letters of Authority were issued to Maria Scalzo for the Estate of Anthony Notarian.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 4 states the appointment entry constitutes letters of authority.
rulings.evidenceQuote: This entry of appointment constitutes the fiduciary's letters of authority.
rulings.judgeReason: The appointment entry states it constitutes the fiduciary's letters of authority, confirming the claim.

rulings.claim: The Estate of Anthony Notarian filed an action against Gino Notarian and other defendants for the return of estate assets.
rulings.reason: The probate order describes a complaint by Maria Scalzo alleging Gino conveyed away estate real property.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Maria Scalzo alleges Gino Notarian concealed, embezzled, or conveyed away real property that belonged to Anthony Notarian to himself as Anthony's power of attorney.
rulings.judgeReason: The probate order describes a complaint by the fiduciary alleging Gino Notarian concealed or conveyed away estate assets, which constitutes an action for return of estate assets.

rulings.claim: The estate-asset action was filed as Case No. 20 PC 000280 in the Geauga County Court of Common Pleas, Probate Division.
rulings.reason: The probate action is identified as Case No. 20 PC 000280 in the Geauga County Probate Division.
rulings.evidenceQuote: IN THE COURT OF COMMON PLEAS PROBATE DIVISION GEAUGA COUNTY, OHIO... CASE NO. 20 PC 000280
rulings.judgeReason: The probate order is captioned with Case No. 20 PC 000280 in the Geauga County Court of Common Pleas, Probate Division, directly supporting the claim.

rulings.claim: In August 2021, Gino Notarian transferred the Cedar Road premises to Julia Notarian.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 5 states Gino transferred the Cedar Road property to Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach on August 27, 2021.
rulings.evidenceQuote: the executrix learned Gino Notarian transferred real property located at 8127 Cedar Road to Julia M. Notarian and Charles Rossbach on August 27, 2021.
rulings.judgeReason: The evidence states Gino Notarian transferred the property to Julia M. Notarian (and Charles Rossbach) on August 27, 2021, supporting the claim of transfer to Julia Notarian.

rulings.claim: In August 2021, Gino Notarian transferred the Cedar Road premises to Charles Rossbach III.
rulings.reason: Exhibit 5 states Gino transferred the Cedar Road property to Julia Notarian and Charles Rossbach on August 27, 2021.
rulings.evidenceQuote: Gino Notarian transferred real property located at 8127 Cedar Road to Julia M. Notarian and Charles Rossbach on August 27, 2021.
rulings.judgeReason: The evidence states the transfer included Charles Rossbach, supporting the claim that Gino Notarian transferred the premises to Charles Rossbach III.
